sum: Here Group Limited designs, develops, and sells collectible consumer products in China. The company offers collectible pop toys, including plush toys and figures, under the HERE brand. It also offers blind boxes, plush toys, and merchandise. The company was formerly known as QuantaSing Group Limited and change its name to Here Group Limited in November 2025. Here Group Limited was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.
ceo: Mr. Peng  Li (Founder, Chairman of the Board & CEO)
